textSegments: Complies with ATX12 v2.52 & EPS12 v2.92
True Power, You Can Count On
With 0.9 Active Power Factor Correction, the V PRO series comes across with guarantee wattage of continuous power, delivers full power to your PC system.
For gaming enthusiast, the HV PRO series features with dual CPU power connectors to support high-end motherboard and provide CPU stable power.
An advanced thermal control fan makes optimal cooling and reduces noise under maximum operation.
Stable DC to DC Output Quality

For maximum efficiency and stable voltage, HV PRO series with DC to DC circuit design offers benefits such as better compatibility and reliability, and high system compatibility especially in cross regulation mode.
HV PRO series follows global safety standard, its grounded design can enhance current stability and ensure safety under maximum operation.
HV Pro series meet 80 PLUS 230V EU Standard and rated for greater efficiency to 85%, so you'll enjoy lower energy bills.
